name: Intercompany Match
office_task: Each month end, match what our group companies say they owe each other in Xero, MYOB or QuickBooks, list every difference with both figures, and fix one only once a named person accepts it.
systems_of_record: the issuing company's ledger file, Xero, MYOB or QuickBooks Online (the intercompany invoice and its id: the Xero InvoiceID, the MYOB invoice UID or the QuickBooks invoice Id)
the receiving company's ledger file, Xero, MYOB or QuickBooks Online (the bill entered for the same charge, carrying the issuer's invoice id as its reference)

emits.write: the month-end intercompany run into the group's reconciliation log: the pair contract id, the key it joined on (the issuer's Xero InvoiceID), the master per field, and the five counts (matched, within tolerance, mismatched, orphaned, corrected), the all-clear included
emits.readback: the log returns a report_id, and reading that id back returns the run with its contract id and counts; no id back means the run did not publish and the contract owner is told

emits.write: an exception on the issuer's Xero InvoiceID naming the contract owner: an open difference with both figures and the master's figure awaiting acceptance, an entry in one company's file with no partner in the other, a gap over the threshold amount, a run over the mismatch rate, or an accepted correction whose write returned no id
emits.readback: the exception desk returns an exception_id, and reading it back returns the issuer's InvoiceID, the reason and the exception_owner; no id back means nothing was raised and the run stops
